evidence_class: deterministic generated analytic scenes and source arithmetic witnesses

correspondence.truth: closed-form scalar-component rigid pose projection of fixed analytic world points
correspondence.motion_contract: previous active UV minus current active UV, including raster shift
correspondence.scope: geometric endpoints, not a claim that all projected points have observed ROI support

analytic_support.scene: one-pixel foreground strip at Z2 moving three pixels over static wall Z8
analytic_support.limitation: exact analytic geometry and object motion; not a mixed-coarse-cell or captured-key purity claim

native_witnesses.scope: source-derived arithmetic witnesses; no GPU execution and no source change
native_witnesses.near_zero_caveat: preserved baseline arithmetic; generic correspondence support rejects zero depth

virtual_transport.scene: planar mirror Z5; real point (1,0,2); virtual image (1,0,8); camera translates +.4X
virtual_transport.scope: analytic planar mirror only; captured alpha/direction role remains unverified

history_trajectory.scope: CPU contract with one physical six-slot bank; no actual command lists/fences executed
